answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a potent Sybil resistance mechanism by tying network influence to capital rather than ephemeral digital identities. An attacker cannot simply wander into the ecosystem to create fake nodes; they must commit locked assets, akin to a falcon surveying prey, which are subject to slashing if they violate protocol. This scarcity of stakes acts like a willow, bending under pressure but remaining rooted in economic truth, forcing attackers to bear the prohibitive cost of acquiring massive circulating supply.
